shapeSummary: 104 x 40 x 3 mm flat plate, with the 40 mm width running Y=0..40 and the thickness centered on Z=0. It has a 42 x 21 mm through pocket centered at x=-26, a Ø14 mm bore at x=32, Ø4 mm holes on the 8 mm grid, and four Ø4 mm holes at the pocket ends.
warnings: Slots (vertical at x=32,y=±16, horizontal near x=18 and x=46 on the centerline) and the oblong holes near (24,8) and (40,-8) are omitted because their lengths are not dimensioned.
The rounded bump on the left end and the pocket corner relief notches are not modeled.
The four M4 holes beside the pocket are modeled as plain Ø4 mm through holes with no threads, and their positions are approximate.
The hole layout was read from the drawing and snapped to the 8 mm grid, so some positions may be slightly off.
The plate lies in the XY plane because the given bounds are x=104, y=40, z=3. The Y offset of +20 puts the bottom edge at Y=0.
cadquery:
pts=[(x,y) for y in (16,-16) for x in list(range(-48,25,8))+[40,48]]
pts+=[(8,8),(16,8),(40,8),(48,8),(8,0),(8,-8),(16,-8),(24,-8),(48,-8)]
tap=[(-50,5),(-50,-5),(-2,5),(-2,-5)]
plate=cq.Workplane('XY').center(0,20).box(104,40,3)
holes=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-2).pushPoints([(x,y+20) for x,y in pts+tap]).circle(2).extrude(4)
pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-2).center(-26,20).rect(42,21).extrude(4)
bore=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-2).center(32,20).circle(7).extrude(4)
part=plate.cut(holes).cut(pocket).cut(bore)
